adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real edge case bug. Looking at the diff in group.js lines 23-35, the findMembers function calculates offset as `Math.min(this.get('user_count'), Math.max(this.get('offset'), 0))`. When a member is removed via removeMember (lines 37-45), it calls findMembers() to reload. If the user was the last member on the final page, the offset could equal the new reduced user_count, resulting in an empty page being displayed. The code doesn't handle adjusting the offset when the current page becomes empty after deletion. This is a legitimate correctness issue in the pagination logic.
